import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { oauthAccessGrants } from "../../../backend/schema/oauth_access_grants";

export const oauthAccessGrantsCms = customizeTable<typeof oauthAccessGrants>("oauth_access_grants", {
    display: {
        title: "token"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "token", "revokedAt", "scopes", "codeChallenge", "codeChallengeMethod"],
    fields: {
        token: {
            multiline: true
        },
        scopes: {
            multiline: true
        },
        codeChallenge: {
            multiline: true
        },
        codeChallengeMethod: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "token",
        "revokedAt",
        "scopes",
        "codeChallenge",
        "codeChallengeMethod",
        "expiresIn",
        "resourceOwner",
        "application",
        "redirectUri",
        "createdAt"
    ]
});
